actual_project_evidence: StoryEventRoot already has direct glyph, preview, target, explicit-cast, and EventClock consumers with a full-viewport SafeBackground.
The tracked WebP resource and import file resolve in Godot 4.7.1; its manifest has the exact field-practicum consumer contract and SHA-256.

implementation_feasibility_recheck.limit: The observed 1280x720 editor state is machine/editor evidence only. Human writing, physical touch, device crop, accessibility, performance, export, release rights, and card rules remain unverified.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: A background could intercept mouse/touch and break direct glyph input.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Use MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE and assert it in the StoryEventRoot integration test.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: A fixed-size raster could leave blank framing in a fixed landscape viewport.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Use STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED and assert the exact enum rather than relying on visual default behavior.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: A reused field image could be mistaken for new artwork or final release promotion.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Record exact unchanged SHA, reuse-only status, conditional rights, source candidate provenance, and no-new-image scope.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: Readable gameplay content could be baked into or obscured by environmental art.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Place a mouse-transparent live readability veil between the environment and Content, leaving text, guide, clocks, buttons, target, and result nodes live.

adversarial_review_loops.finding: A code-only result could omit real Godot editor/runtime evidence or leave generated clutter.
adversarial_review_loops.correction: Reload and save through the exact Godot editor, run/capture/diagnose StoryEventRoot, preserve one runtime evidence image, and remove only verified untracked import/UID/temp byproducts.
